# Siegu

> Siegu is an open-source, private, local-first photo library for Windows, macOS and Linux. It keeps your photos and metadata on your device and uses on-device AI for search, organization and deduplication — nothing is uploaded for processing. Sharing works over live, end-to-end-encrypted links; remote access uses a self-hosted relay or Siegu's hosted relay (Pro). Free for personal use, no cloud account, works offline.

## Core product

- [Home](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/): overview, live demo and download
- [Features](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/#features): what Siegu does
- [Download](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/download.html): installers for Windows, macOS and Linux
- [Pricing](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/pricing.html): Free ($0), Pro ($7.99/month billed yearly), Family ($23.99/month billed yearly)
- [Compare](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/compare.html): Siegu vs. cloud photo services
- [Import from Google Photos](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/guide-google-photos.html): step-by-step guide using Google Takeout (runs locally, nothing uploaded)
- [Connect](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/connect.html): connecting your devices over any network
- [FAQ](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/faq.html): common questions
- [What "private, on-device, relay, TURN" mean](https://denzyldick.github.io/siegu/faq.html) — data never leaves your device for processing; a relay only forwards the encrypted stream between your own devices and never stores or reads media.
